strapiBlog.title: Wasl Unveils 'The Next Chapter' Masterplan for Jumeirah Golf Estates
strapiBlog.short_description: Dubai continues to attract global attention with its bold and innovative real estate projects.

data.text:
Dubai continues to attract global attention with its bold and innovative real estate projects. One of the latest highlights is Wasl’s launch of ‘The Next Chapter’ at Jumeirah Golf Estates — a project that’s raising the bar for luxury golf communities in the city.

Spanning an impressive 4.68 million square meters, this ambitious expansion promises to redefine modern living by blending lush green spaces with forward-thinking urban design.

All About the Jumeirah Golf Estates Expansion

The Jumeirah Golf Estates development 2025 plan, called ‘The Next Chapter’, emphasizes Dubai's commitment to sustainable living, aligned with the Dubai 2040 Urban Master Plan.

Housing more than 51,700 residents, this new phase of Jumeirah Golf Estates will feature over 12,345 exceptional residential units, marking it as one of Dubai's mega real estate projects. These include luxurious villas, ultra-luxury hilltop mansions, branded residences, estate homes, and apartments.

What sets apart the new phases of Jumeirah Golf Estates is their distinctive, luxurious lifestyle. Divided into six diverse districts—Central Park, Village, Town Centre & Grand Lake, Golf Course North & South, and Equestrian Village—each offers uniquely curated experiences ranging from golf course villas in Dubai to vibrant mixed-use urban spaces.

Residents will enjoy a variety of prestigious residential choices, including:

  • 780 Luxurious Villas
  • 62 Ultra-Luxury Hilltop Mansions
  • 97 Branded Residences
  • 752 Estate Homes
  • 10,654 Apartments

All residences are harmoniously set amidst 1.51 million sqm of verdant green spaces.

Location & Connectivity

Positioned strategically along Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, the Jumeirah Golf Estates expansion is strategically designed to enhance connectivity and ease of travel for residents.

The project is directly linked to the Etihad Rail station currently under construction, and conveniently adjacent to the Jumeirah Golf Estates Metro Station. This connectivity, coupled with proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport, positions it prominently as an internationally recognized destination for modern luxury living.

World-Class Amenities & Sporting Excellence

Jumeirah Golf Estates development 2025 promises an unparalleled sporting experience, featuring world-class facilities designed to cater to active lifestyles and elite sporting events:

  • A meticulously designed 18-hole golf course, enhanced by a cutting-edge driving range and dedicated golf academy.
  • Dubai’s largest tennis stadium, boasting an impressive capacity of over 5,000 spectators, ideal for international tournaments and vibrant community events.
  • A premier equestrian center, specifically geared towards show jumping with advanced training arenas and luxurious stabling facilities.
  • Comprehensive recreational amenities, including sophisticated fitness centers, swimming pools, and beautifully designed lakes, fostering a vibrant community spirit.
  • These exceptional amenities collectively establish the Jumeirah Golf Estates as a prestigious and dynamic sports hub.

The Next Chapter Focuses on Sustainability

Catering to daily life, this Dubai mega real estate project incorporates extensive community infrastructure, including international academies, nurseries, healthcare facilities, mosques, and over 48,000 sqm dedicated to retail and dining zones. A luxurious Mandarin Oriental Hotel further enriches the community experience.

At its core, the Jumeirah Golf Estates expansion emphasizes sustainable living, ensuring active, eco-friendly lifestyles through its expansive Central Park and dedicated green spaces. This visionary approach aims to set new standards for future urban development in Dubai.

faqs.question: When will the new phases of Jumeirah Golf Estates be completed?

data.answer: The Next Chapter is set to be completed and fully operational by the end of 2025, marking a significant milestone in Dubai’s ambitious real estate expansion.

faqs.question: What type of residences are available in the expansion?

data.answer: The expansion includes luxurious villas, ultra-luxury hilltop mansions, branded residences, estate homes, and apartments.

faqs.question: How well connected is the Jumeirah Golf Estates expansion?

data.answer: The expansion features direct access to Etihad Rail and Dubai Metro stations and proximity to major highways and Al Maktoum International Airport.

faqs.question: Are there golf course villas in this project?

data.answer: Yes, the development features premium golf course villas in Dubai overlooking an 18-hole golf course.
